description: Rule-level suppressions for the PAM doctor-curated pass. Each entry needs a written reason.

suppressions.reason: POSIX fdopen: close(fd) only when fdopen fails, fclose only when it succeeds. cppcheck 2.13 does not model the ownership transfer. The sentinel fd=-1 plus (void)fd was reverted: it existed to quiet the tools and did not change behavior. Revisit if a new doubleFree appears in this file. See hygiene/pam-doctor/2026-11-08-pass-1.md.

Same fdopen ownership gap, in load_config_file. Scoped to this file because the curator has no line filter. A new doubleFree in pam_ezkey.c must reopen this entry rather than be ignored. See hygiene/pam-doctor/2026-11-08-pass-1.md.

Empty cancel token and unrecognized cancel token both become EZKEY_CANCEL_SKIPPED on purpose. Two reasons, one outcome. Merging the branches would hide that. A new branch-clone in this file must reopen this entry. See hygiene/pam-doctor/2026-11-08-pass-1.md.
